say:1:1033206001:1.text: They're all doing well. The Patrollers helped us find a healer. They're treating everyone right now, and I reckon it won't be long until they're all better.
say:1:1033206001:1.source_cn: 都好，都好。巡游队帮我们找来了医师，正在给大家治疗呢，...
say:1:1033206001:1.male: They're all doing well. The Patrollers helped us find a healer. They're treating everyone right now, and I reckon it won't be long until they're all better.
say:1:1033206001:1.female: They're all doing well. The Patrollers helped us find a healer. They're treating everyone right now, and I reckon it won't be long until they're all better.

say:2:1033206002:1.text: This is all thanks to you, and these kind forest folk.
say:2:1033206002:1.source_cn: 这都是多亏了你们，还有这些好心的丛林人。
say:2:1033206002:1.male: This is all thanks to you, and these kind forest folk.
say:2:1033206002:1.female: This is all thanks to you, and these kind forest folk.

say:3:1033206003:1.text: Regardless of whether we can enter the forest in the future, we will always remember your kindness.
say:3:1033206003:1.source_cn: 不管以后能不能再进入丛林，我们都会永远记得你们的恩情。
say:3:1033206003:1.male: Regardless of whether we can enter the forest in the future, we will always remember your kindness.
say:3:1033206003:1.female: Regardless of whether we can enter the forest in the future, we will always remember your kindness.
